Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.
We are seeking a Lead Power BI Engineer to support the client in the development and modernization of Power BI reporting solutions used by turnaround management teams. The engineer will work on either Cost Controlling Reporting, rebuilding an existing solution in a new Power BI workspace and transitioning toward data exposed from SAP through CDS views, or Scheduling & Progress Reporting, developing a Power BI solution combining SAP and Oracle Primavera data. The role focuses on the Power BI application and semantic layer, requiring strength in semantic modeling, DAX, Power Query, report development, performance optimization and security, alongside close collaboration with business stakeholders.
 Requirements
5+ years of relevant BI/analytics experience, with strong recent hands-on Power BI development experience
Proven delivery of complex production-grade Power BI solutions rather than primarily self-service or ad-hoc reporting
Experience building Power BI solutions from a blank workspace through development, validation and production deployment
Expertise in Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service and advanced DAX
Proficiency in Power Query / M, semantic and analytical data modeling, and star-schema and dimensional modeling principles
Skills in developing complex measures, calculated columns, KPI logic, relationship design and filter-context design
Background in report and dashboard development, Power BI visualization and analytical UX best practices
Knowledge of Row-Level Security (RLS), workspace and access management, and dataset/semantic-model refresh configuration
Competency in Power BI model and report performance optimization and troubleshooting complex Power BI solutions
Familiarity with testing, reconciliation and validation of BI calculations, and migration or rebuild of reports where underlying data sources are changing
Understanding of Git / version-control concepts and structured software development practices
Experience implementing RLS and enterprise access-control requirements, working with business stakeholders to translate KPIs into technical implementations, and working in distributed enterprise delivery teams
English proficiency at B2 level or higher
 Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Power BI reports and dashboards from the ground up in a new Power BI workspace
Rebuild and modernize existing reports while preserving validated business logic, KPIs and reporting requirements
Create robust and maintainable Power BI semantic models supporting cost, scheduling and turnaround-management reporting
Develop advanced DAX measures, calculated columns and calculation logic required for KPIs and analytical use cases
Use Power Query / M where appropriate for transformations within the Power BI solution
Develop intuitive visualizations, drill-down capabilities, filtering and analytical navigation for turnaround managers
Configure and manage datasets, semantic models, reports and associated assets within Power BI Service
Work directly with the client's turnaround management, scheduling and cost-controlling stakeholders
Review existing reports and documentation to understand established KPIs, measures and business rules
Translate functional requirements into Power BI models, DAX logic and visualizations
Collaborate closely with the client's internal SAP, data and technical teams responsible for SQL, CDS views and backend/data preparation
Provide clear technical documentation covering Power BI models, measures, reporting logic and configuration
 We offer

All-around Social package: professional & soft skills training, medical & family care programs, sports
Free English classes
Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
Continuous experience exchange with experts and professionals worldwide
Friendly team and comfortable working environment
Engineering, corporate, and social events within and outside the Company
Flexible working schedule
Opportunities for self-realization
